_what: Bibliographic metadata for every identifier cited by the four submission-form manuscripts, retrieved 2026-08-09 so their reference lists can be completed from a fetch rather than from recollection.
_why: All four drafting agents independently reported incomplete reference lists as their common submission blocker, and all four REFUSED to supply authors, titles or journals they could not source. That refusal is correct and is the reason this file exists: on 2026-08-07 a PMID written from memory plus six invented titles reached a manuscript and passed lint_claims twice.
⛔_this_run_is_the_first_in_this_reposito: MEASURED 2026-08-09. fetch-paper.mjs projected `journal: r.journalTitle`; Europe PMC nests it at `journalInfo.journal.title` and returns no flat field, so `journal` was ALWAYS undefined and JSON.stringify dropped the key entirely. Every _index.json this repository had ever produced carried title, authors, year and doi and NO journal - silently, with no error and no empty field to notice. It surfaced only when four manuscripts needed journal names at once. Fixed in the same session; volume, issue, pages and the ISO abbreviation were added for the same reason.

⚠_two_identifiers_did_not_resolve.meaning: Europe PMC returned no record for these under EXT_ID. They may be indexed only in another source, may be wrong in the citing prose, or may not exist. ⛔ DO NOT write a reference for either from recollection - resolve or remove them.
